description: PathSimR is published by NHS BNSSG Analytics. PathSimR provides a Shiny interface, input templates and a four-case use library for discrete-event healthcare-pathway simulation in R. Its stated coverage is Generic healthcare pathways; local configuration required. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is GPL-3.0. The published templates are illustrative and explicitly do not represent real pathways. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
